DeterminationBasis: T13-002 directly establishes temporal preservation across changed or corrected runs: the later result remains separate, the earlier FAIL remains preserved, and failure occurs if a later PASS rewrites the predecessor FAIL. This directly satisfies TEST-007's requirement that a later passing successor test SHALL NOT erase evidence of an earlier failing test.

T16-001 requires a material claim to remain bounded to established evidence and scope, requires preservation of the evaluated scope, evidence basis and applicable status, and fails where the claim materially exceeds what the evidence establishes. A bounded PASS represented as universal validation would exceed the evaluated scope and evidence basis; therefore TEST-008 is already covered by T16-001.
